D&D Homebrew > Reworks > Silvery Barbs

Silvery Barbs

Spell

1st level Illusion
Casting Time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself succeeds on an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw
Range: 60 ft.
Components: V
Duration: Instantaneous

You magically distract the triggering creature, potentially causing it to fumble where it would otherwise succeed. The triggering creature must reroll the d20 and use the lower roll.

Spell Lists: Bard, Sorcerer, Wizard
